roles.name: Interpreter / Envoy Mage
roles.design: An approachable young adult male envoy with warm chestnut skin, short soft silver hair swept to one side, expressive amber eyes and a small kind smile. Teal short travel coat with ivory collar and sleeves, muted coral neck scarf, dark navy trousers, brown boots. One small brass speech-shell brooch on upper chest and a tiny CLOSED message-scroll case fixed at the SCREEN-RIGHT belt. No large cape or hat. Lean gentle face but same substantial compact body.
roles.gesture: Open palms toward an unseen listener, gentle conversational chanting.

roles.name: Researcher / Diviner
roles.design: A curious young adult male diviner with medium warm skin, chestnut wavy short hair, moss-hazel eyes, rounded modest spectacles with visible eyes. Ochre short shoulder mantle ending above elbows over an ivory blouse and olive sleeveless tunic, cocoa trousers, sturdy dark boots. One SMALL amber lens in a bronze CLOSED belt cradle at SCREEN-RIGHT, always attached. No held orb, no giant hat. Thoughtful friendly expression.
roles.gesture: Palms frame a small empty space before waist, gazing thoughtfully; no orb drawn.

roles.name: Writer / Storyweaver
roles.design: A bright young adult female storyweaver with warm light-medium skin, copper-red hair in one short low side braid, green eyes and friendly smile. Muted brick-red knee-above split coat, cream blouse with rolled broad cuffs, plum waist sash, dark brown trousers, tan cuffed boots. One short ivory quill tucked firmly into a small CLOSED leather belt pen case at SCREEN-RIGHT, never held. Small round brass collar pin. No dress, tall hat or long flowing hair.
roles.gesture: One open hand makes a tiny tracing gesture in empty air at chest height, other hand supports at waist. No letters or ink trails.

roles.name: Reviewer / Ward Inspector
roles.design: A calm adult male inspector with warm tan skin, straight charcoal hair swept back in short layers, subtle gray streak at one temple, violet-brown eyes, slightly angular eyebrows and kindly composed expression; no beard. Deep aubergine short coat with muted silver edging over ash-ivory shirt, dark teal waist sash, charcoal trousers and dark brown boots. One SMALL rectangular sealed silver inspection token fixed at SCREEN-RIGHT belt. No armor, weapon, hood or cape.
roles.gesture: One open palm faces gently outward near chest as if testing a ward; other open hand low and relaxed.

roles.name: Proofreader / Rune Corrector
roles.design: A meticulous young adult female rune corrector with pale warm skin, dusty rose short hair with neat rounded side locks and a small cream hair ribbon, expressive muted blue eyes, thin oval brass spectacles with clear eyes. Sage-gray short tunic coat with ivory cuffs, dusty rose waist sash, brown fitted trousers, cocoa boots. One tiny CLOSED wooden correction-stamp case fixed at SCREEN-RIGHT belt; nothing held. Gentle attentive expression. No school uniform, giant bow, skirt or hat.
roles.gesture: Open hands make small precise pinching gestures near lower chest without touching; both palms visible, no held object.

roles.name: Tester / Field Alchemist
roles.design: An energetic young adult female field alchemist with medium brown skin, short sandy-blond hair in a tiny stubby ponytail, hazel eyes and a confident cheerful face. Muted mustard short practical vest over an ivory broad-cuffed shirt, petrol-blue neckerchief, dark olive trousers, brown sturdy boots and simple brown belt. One tiny CLOSED turquoise test-vial holder at SCREEN-RIGHT belt, vial stays sealed and attached. No goggles over eyes, armor, large bag or hat.
roles.gesture: Palms held asymmetrically at waist and chest as if carefully testing a spell, small focused finger changes.

roles.name: Images / Illusion Painter
roles.design: A playful young adult male illusion painter with golden tan skin, short tousled dark indigo hair with one muted turquoise lock, warm plum eyes and slight charming smile. Muted turquoise short open coat with plum lining, ivory shirt and cuffs, ochre narrow sash, charcoal trousers, brown/navy cuffed boots. One SMALL capped paintbrush inside a CLOSED narrow leather belt case at SCREEN-RIGHT; never held. No beret, huge brush, cape or paint splashes.
roles.gesture: Two open hands frame a small imagined composition in empty air at lower chest, tiny wrist changes; no drawing, image panel or emitted trail.

roles.name: Librarian / Archive Keeper
roles.design: A gentle adult female archive keeper with warm dark brown skin, dark plum hair in a compact low bun with two short cheek locks, amber eyes and small round brass spectacles with clearly visible eyes. Deep moss-green short split coat over ivory high-collar blouse with wide cuffs, muted burgundy sash, dark brown trousers, sturdy brown boots. One SMALL CLOSED tan book secured flush in a leather SCREEN-RIGHT belt cradle, no loose pages. Calm soft smile. No robe, giant book, hat or flowing cape.
roles.gesture: Open palms held comfortably like supporting an invisible open book at waist, but no physical book or orb appears in hands.

common:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production transparent pixel-art body sprites for the EXACT existing character in image1.
IDENTITY LOCK: {DESIGN} Match image1's actual accepted face, hair silhouette, head/body balance, proportions, clothes cut, material colors, cuffs, belt, boots and attached small role prop in EVERY frame. This is an animation of the SAME person, not a new outfit/concept. Adult cute JRPG appeal, moderately enlarged head, visible short neck, substantial compact torso, real knees and sturdy boots. Do not inflate head or add hair volume, portrait detail, long limbs or new accessories.
EMPTY-HAND MAGIC: All physical role props remain SECURED at their original screen-RIGHT belt mount or collar throughout EVERY action, including casting. No drawing, handing over, stowing or duplicating tools. Both hands stay EMPTY. Magic is spoken/gestured; all emitted light and the shared ground circle are separate assets. No orb or physical object magically appears between palms. Fingers should read as simple small coherent pixel clusters.
CAMERA/ANATOMY: Elevated FRONT THREE-QUARTER, facing LOWER-LEFT throughout. BOTH eyes visible, far eye narrower, front of chest and narrow side plane visible, hair crown and boot tops. Head, chest, pelvis, knees and toes share the heading. No one-eye profile, frontal torso with sideways legs, camera rotation or mirroring within sheet. NEAR shoulder/hip begins SCREEN-RIGHT, FAR begins SCREEN-LEFT and goes behind on overlap. Trace continuous shoulder→elbow→hand and hip→knee→ankle→boot; sides keep ownership through crossings. Use slightly lighter near trousers and darker far trousers without changing palette.
LAYOUT: exact action count and equal cells, row-major order. One whole body per cell, fixed dimensions, head width, limb lengths, camera, neutral pelvis/root position. Crown around7% and planted soles around90% of each standing cell, generous side margins, all fingers/boots/hair inside cell. Small walk bob only. No independent silhouette re-centering or scaling to fill cells. Lifted feet stay lifted; seated figure is shorter than standing, NEVER enlarged. Planted poses hold boot/root anchors steady.
PIXEL CUTOUT: Crisp stepped contours, deliberate grouped colors and coherent coarse grid, upper-left neutral material shading, readable at96×96 logical cells. Opaque body pixels, actual transparent RGBA outside and in limb gaps. No smooth anime painting, glossy3D, fine texture noise, blur, halo, colored fringe, outline sticker or translucent body. No shadow, floor, pedestal, scenery, backdrop, checkerboard drawing, labels, numbers, captions, gridlines, borders or watermark. ABSOLUTELY NO light, sparks, aura, magic circles or effect pixels baked into the sheet. Image2 when supplied is specifically described in ACTION: use it only for that role, not extra costumes or guide marks.

actions.idle: FOUR frames, 2×2 equal SQUARE cells. Standing IDLE:1 canonical relaxed standing, friendly open eyes, hands down EMPTY, role prop secured;2 subtle exhale and slightly lowered eyelids;3 brief natural closed-eye blink;4 open eyes and small return breath toward1. Same soles, belt/root, neck base and arm placements, very small motion only. No touching tool, waving, turning or swaying.
actions.walk: FOUR frames, 2×2 equal SQUARE cells, row-major WALK LOOP. Image2 is the code-projected four-pose anatomy guide ONLY: pink=near, teal=far; translate to real clothes and remove guide marks. 1 NEAR CONTACT: lighter near leg from SCREEN-RIGHT hip crosses toward forward/down-left heel, darker far leg trails up-right with heel raised; near arm back far arm forward. 2 FAR PASSING: near foot supports beneath pelvis, FAR knee advances, lifted boot passes beside support shin; arms pass neutral, narrow stance. 3 FAR CONTACT: darker FAR leg from SCREEN-LEFT hip now leads down-left heel, lighter near leg trails up-right toe; near arm forward far arm back. Must be OPPOSITE anatomical lead to1, not only changed arms. 4 NEAR PASSING: far foot supports, NEAR knee/boot lifts and passes support shin, opposite lifted leg to2. Modest ordinary walk on two narrow depth tracks, forward means left AND toward viewer, backward right AND away. Head/chest/pelvis/knees/toes share heading. No lateral straddle, crab walk, backward knees, kicks, run or whole-body airborne phase. Small bob only, stable hair/costume. Exactly four useful contact/pass/opposite-contact/opposite-pass poses, no eight-frame sheet or duplicates. Prop stays attached, hands empty.
actions.sit: TWO frames, 2 columns×1 row of equal SQUARE cells, wide sheet. Seated rest on invisible ground, comfortably folded bent legs in front, empty hands resting on thighs, role prop still secured.1 friendly relaxed open eyes;2 brief calm closed-eye blink with tiny breathing motion. Keep SAME physical head/body dimensions as master; naturally lower crown than standing, do NOT enlarge to fill cell. Same lower-left three-quarter camera. No chair, stump, cushions, floor or added objects.
actions.cast-start: FOUR frames, 2×2 equal SQUARE cells. Begin empty-handed chanting; feet planted, belt/root fixed, attached props stay secured.1 exact canonical empty-handed standing idle;2 elbows begin bending, EMPTY hands lift from sides toward waist, eyes focus;3 hands continue toward this role's specific working gesture;4 fully established held chanting pose: {GESTURE} Both hands EMPTY, simple fingers. No prop removal, touching belt, duplicated tool or new object. No glow or magic drawn into body. Keep endpoint clear and comfortable at waist/lower chest, below face. Frame4 is canonical reference for later loop/end.
actions.cast-loop: FOUR frames, 2×2 equal SQUARE cells. Image2 is the canonical casting-start endpoint; preserve its EXACT arm/hand placement and physical scale. Hold role-specific gesture: {GESTURE} Both EMPTY hands remain anatomically connected, all physical props stay secured at belt/collar.1 exact held endpoint;2 small wrist/finger downbeat and slightly open chanting mouth;3 tiny upbeat, eyelids briefly lower;4 return close to1, mouth softens. Feet, pelvis, neck and head base fixed. Very small gestures, no torso rotation, arm waving or hand swaps. No physical orb/book/tool appears between palms. No effect, circle, glow or emitted strokes in body sheet.
actions.cast-end: FOUR frames, 2×2 equal SQUARE cells. Image2 is canonical casting-start endpoint; start from EXACT same held arm pose and scale.1 established EMPTY-handed chanting gesture;2 relax fingers and begin lowering hands toward waist;3 arms lower almost to natural sides, chanting mouth closes;4 canonical friendly open-eyed idle matching standing master, both hands EMPTY down at sides. Physical role prop remains secured at original belt/collar throughout, never moved. Feet/root fixed; no stepping, bowing or rotating. No magic effect in body. End connects exactly to idle.
